$description: Appearance-invariant base tokens and press-scale override for the shadcn neutral theme.

designMd.overview: shadcn/ui's neutral palette paired with flat surfaces (`state.press-scale: 1`) and Tailwind-style border/shadow lifts (`references/shadcn-ui` `new-york-v4`).
designMd.elevation: Flat elevation model: cards and floating surfaces sit on neutral background steps with subtle drop shadows and crisp 1px borders rather than inner specular highlights or glass blur.
dos: Keep press interactions flat (`state.press-scale: 1`); signal hover and press via surface and opacity changes.
Preserve the 31 shadcn A-layer color slots (`background`, `foreground`, `card`, `primary`, `secondary`, `muted`, `accent`, `destructive`, `border`, `input`, `ring`, `chart-1..5`, `sidebar*`).
donts: Do not add backdrop blur, specular rim highlights, or spring press shrink to flat shadcn finishes.

radius.$description: Base corner radius scale referenced by semantic shape roles.

control.$description: Corner radius for in-page controls, fields, rows, chips, badges, wells, color areas, and kbd.

container.$description: Corner radius for cards, menus, popovers, tooltips, list panels, toasts, and frames.

modal.$description: Corner radius for dialogs, sheets, and drawers.

mono.$description: Monospace font family for code blocks and numeric readouts.

color.$description: Appearance-invariant C-layer color roles shared by light and dark modes.

brand-fill.$description: Primary brand action fill, aliased to {color.primary}.

on-brand.$description: Foreground text and icons on brand-fill surfaces, aliased to {color.primary-foreground}.

scrim.$description: Translucent backdrop scrim behind modals and sheets (50% black).

media.$description: Ground behind photographs and videos; invariant across appearances.

on-media.$description: White ink over photographs and dark media surfaces; invariant across appearances.

chart-foreground.$description: Dark ink on light chart tiles; dark tiles use on-media.

window-close.$description: macOS window close traffic-light fill mapped to shadcn destructive red.

window-minimize.$description: macOS window minimize traffic-light fill mapped to shadcn ring grey.

window-zoom.$description: macOS window zoom traffic-light fill mapped to shadcn chart-4 grey.

window-control-ink.$description: Glyph ink inside macOS window traffic-light buttons.

window-control-edge.$description: Hairline border around macOS window traffic-light buttons.

state.$description: Interaction state opacities, press scale, and ripple switch.

press-scale.$description: Scale factor applied while pressed (1 disables press shrinking for flat shadcn surfaces).
